subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Review Unit 1 words about new media, blogs and the news.
Use phrasal verbs and comparatives like 'not as … as' correctly.
Correct mistakes in sentences that describe a chart.

tf.s: A blog is a regular online record of your thoughts.
tf.why: Yes! Bloggers post their ideas online regularly.

tf.s: 'Football is more popular than chess' = 'Chess is not as popular as football.'
tf.why: Correct, both sentences have the same meaning.

tf.s: 'Back up your files' means make a copy so you don't lose them.
tf.why: Right, backing up keeps your files safe.

tf.s: Fake news is always based on facts.
tf.why: Fake news is not based on facts, so check the source.

tf.s: A pie chart summary should use the past continuous tense.
tf.why: We describe charts in the present simple.

tf.s: 'Not as … as' is followed by the comparative form, e.g. 'not as bigger as'.
tf.why: We use the base form: 'not as big as'.

tf.s: Followers are people who follow your social media account.
tf.why: Well done, more followers means more people see your posts.
Yes, people can communicate and take part.

tf.s: A printed newspaper is more interactive than a blog.
tf.why: A blog lets readers comment; a printed newspaper is one-way.

boxes.q: I log ___ to the website with my password.

o: Chess is not as popular as football.
Chess is not as more popular as football.
Chess is not popular as as football.

boxes.q: Which word starts a summary of the main idea of a chart?
Which is a good way to avoid fake news?
boxes.why: A trusted source gives true information.

boxes.q: A circle divided into slices is a ...
boxes.why: Each slice shows a part of the whole.

boxes.q: Which is an example of new media?
boxes.why: Social media is online and interactive.
A screenager spends a lot of time in front of a screen.

boxes.q: Which shows the most popular platform?
o: YouTube is the most popular platform.
YouTube is most popular than platform.
YouTube is the more popular platform of all.
boxes.why: 'The most' compares one with all others.

mcq.q: Correct: 'I click in the link and log out the website.'
o: I click on the link and log out of the website.
I click at the link and log out in the website.
I clicks in the link and logs out the website.
I click in the link and log off on the website.
mcq.why: We say 'click on' and 'log out of'.

mcq.q: Rewrite: 'Taxis are more expensive than buses.'
o: Buses are not as expensive as taxis.
Taxis are not as expensive as buses.
Buses are not as more expensive as taxis.
Buses are as expensive as taxis.
mcq.why: Swap the items and use the base adjective.

mcq.q: Choose the best sentence for a pie chart summary.
o: Overall, YouTube is the most popular platform.
Overall, I love YouTube so much.
Overall, YouTube were the most popular.
mcq.why: It is objective and uses correct grammar.

o: The chart show that football are popular.
The chart shows that football is popular.
Girls prefer swimming, while boys prefer football.
Poetry is the least popular genre.
mcq.why: It should be 'The chart shows that football is popular.'

mcq.q: Why is a blog an example of new media?
o: Readers can comment and communicate with the writer.
Only one person can read it.

mcq.q: Which is the best learning goal for Unit 2?
o: I will practise reading texts faster.
I will finish the book in one day.
mcq.why: A good goal is clear and realistic.
